products.name: LMSYS Arena Models
products.note: Model evaluation platform; crowdsourced benchmarking; research transparency; no production use

profile_text.body:
LMSYS operates lmarena.ai, a community-driven platform for evaluating and ranking large language models. The site describes itself as an official AI ranking and LLM leaderboard where users can chat with, compare, and vote on AI models across categories including language, image, and code generation. User conversations are disclosed to relevant AI providers and may be shared publicly to support research, and the platform also uses conversations for automated evaluation by sending prompts to AI providers at a later time to score and compare models.

The organization's primary tracked product is LMSYS Arena Models, characterized as a model evaluation platform built around crowdsourced benchmarking and research transparency, with no production use intended. LMSYS is verified as a nonprofit organization. No litigation, patent filings, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts.
